title: Warranty Desk Summary: Completion, Manufacturer Registration and Inspection of Replacement System Installations
content:
# Completion, registration and inspection

## At completion

When a Replacement System Installations project is completed, the Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty is issued on the new equipment, together with the package's included protection tier where it is not "none" and any protection tier bought as a labor-warranty upgrade, each issued with the installation as its purchase channel. A financed project's lender funding is then requested. The replaced unit is marked replaced in the equipment register by the records team.

## Manufacturer registration

Harbison registers the new equipment with the manufacturer.

**Registration window.** A registration confirms the registered parts term only when it is submitted no later than the package's registration window (60 calendar days on every package) after the installation was completed.

- **Clock start:** the installation date recorded on the project, which is day 0.
- **Counting:** calendar days.
- **Boundary:** a registration submitted on the last day qualifies.

| Registration | Parts term recorded |
|---|---|
| Submitted on or before the last day of the window | The package's registered parts term |
| Submitted after the window | The package's unregistered parts term |
| Never submitted | The manufacturer's unregistered term applies |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical installation on 2026-03-02, day 0)

- Submitted 2026-05-01 (day 60): timely — the registered parts term is recorded.
- Submitted 2026-05-02 (day 61): late — the unregistered parts term is recorded.

## Inspection and close-out

The municipal inspection follows installation. A failed inspection is corrected at no charge and re-inspected. The project closes once it is inspected with a zero balance.

| Stage | Moves to |
|---|---|
| Installed | Inspected, when the municipal mechanical inspection passes |
| Inspected | Closed, when the project balance is settled |
